measurement: 1-minute checks from an independent monitor over the agreement period

clauses.SLA-1: Uptime commitment — at least 99.50% of the service period.
clauses.SLA-2: Maintenance exclusion — downtime during a maintenance window is excluded only if announced at least 24 hours in advance.
clauses.SLA-3: Partial credit — 98.00%–99.49% uptime yields a 25% refund.
clauses.SLA-4: Full credit — below 98.00% uptime yields a 100% refund.
clauses.SLA-5: No credit at or above the 99.50% commitment.
clauses.SLA-6: Evidence hierarchy — the independent monitor is primary; the provider status page and maintenance feed are corroborating. If the monitor's coverage of the period is insufficient to determine uptime, the outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

notes: Authoritative terms. Validators read this document to interpret the monitor evidence. Keep it public and commit-pinned.
